coordinate_contract.native_and_resampled_triangles: NW-SE diagonal; sample barycentric interpolation on the selected triangle
coordinate_contract.coarse_lattice_anchor: native grid index (row=0,col=0), x=0,z=12282; factor f samples only native vertices (r,c) where both indices are multiples of f
coordinate_contract.P: one P value per native cell, selected by half-open cell index; never blended between cells
coordinate_contract.F: NW,NE,SW,SE samples interpolated only within that native cell triangle; no across-cell averaging
coordinate_contract.patch_samples: 1.5m grid at x=0.75+1.5k, z=12282-(0.75+1.5j), avoiding native cell seams

interpretation_limits: Per-object masks use the reported local visual bbox transformed by the WRP position. A bbox is not an exact P3D face footprint; samples can include empty portions, and separate object summaries may overlap.
This evaluates sampled height envelopes only. It does not emulate terrain LOD selection, screen-space sampling, Z ordering, material/shader behavior, or runtime water waves.
B and EV95 are separate numerical baselines; no EV73 screenshot or visual symptom is transferred to either.

P and F are sampled fields and not exact runtime water intersections. Positive coarse-minus-F means the sampled coarse terrain is higher than that F surface at that point, not proof that the engine renders it in front.
samples_note: Contains coordinates, cell IDs, P/F and native/coarse H samples for B and EV95.
